queries.name: L01412_august_original
queries.sql:
SELECT d AS header,l AS line FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l
          ON d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry AND d.source_system=l.source_system
          WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.source_table='OINV' AND l.source_table='INV1'
          AND d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>='2026-08-01' AND d.doc_date<'2026-09-01'
          AND l.item_code='L01412'

queries.name: 07_currency_universe
queries.sql:
SELECT x.product_business_type,x.status,d.currency header_currency,
              l.currency line_currency,COUNT(*) line_count,COUNT(DISTINCT l.item_code) product_count,
              SUM(CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) original_amount FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l ON d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry AND d.source_system=l.source_system
              LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') x ON x."ItemCode"=l.item_code
              WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.source_table='OINV' AND l.source_table='INV1'
              AND d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>=? AND d.doc_date<? GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

queries.name: 07_independent_full_ranking
queries.sql:
SELECT l.item_code,
              SUM(CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) amount,COUNT(*) line_count,
              COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_entry) document_count FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l ON d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry AND d.source_system=l.source_system
              LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') x ON x."ItemCode"=l.item_code
              WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.source_table='OINV' AND l.source_table='INV1'
              AND d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>=? AND d.doc_date<?
              AND x.product_business_type='LAB_FINISHED_PRODUCT'
              GROUP BY l.item_code ORDER BY amount DESC,l.item_code ASC
